notes: v656 - every pending order now tells you on its own row whether your price has been reached. Under each order you will see either 'your price was reached on [date]' in green, or 'price not reached - cheapest since you ordered was $X, N% above your limit'. It is worked out from COMPLETED trading sessions saved on your device, so it is settled fact rather than a live guess - the delayed-price button covers today. One deliberate detail: the day you PLACED the order does not count. This app reads closing prices, so by the time you act that day is over and its low happened before your order existed; counting it would tell you a fill was missed when nothing was missed. That is the same rule the fill engine itself uses. If a row says your price was reached and the order is still sitting there, load fresh prices and it should fill. Practice money only. Hard-refresh (Ctrl+F5).
